name: Cloudflare
description: Scoped Cloudflare zone, typed DNS record and explicit cache purge operations.

permissions.description: Deliberately executed nodes call only api.cloudflare.com using a scoped token; confirmed nodes change zones/DNS or purge cached resources. Custom tokenSecret names must also be authorized in the host. No automatic retries or background listeners.

definitions.description: Replace AAAA Record
definitions.documentation: Replace AAAA Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed AAAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. definitions.name: Create TXT Record
definitions.description: Create TXT Record
definitions.documentation: Create TXT Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed TXT request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.documentation: Replace MX Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed MX request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Replace NS Record
definitions.description: Replace NS Record
definitions.documentation: Replace NS Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed NS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Create CAA Record
definitions.description: Create CAA Record
definitions.documentation: Create CAA Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace CAA Record
definitions.description: Replace CAA Record
definitions.documentation: Replace CAA Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed CAA request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Create SSHFP Record
definitions.description: Create SSHFP Record
definitions.documentation: Create SSHFP Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SSHFP request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace SSHFP Record
definitions.description: Replace SSHFP Record
definitions.documentation: Replace SSHFP Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed SSHFP request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create DS Record
definitions.description: Create DS Record
definitions.documentation: Create DS Record. POST /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation CREATE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed DS request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.name: Replace URI Record
definitions.description: Replace URI Record
definitions.documentation: Replace URI Record. PUT /zones/{zoneId}/dns_records/{recordId}. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation REPLACE_DNS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Typed URI request; PUT replaces the complete record, omitted optional fields are not a patch. TTL 1 means auto; 30–59 needs Enterprise opt-in. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. Sources: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/zones/methods/edit/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/create/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/dns/subresources/records/methods/update/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/cache/methods/purge/ https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/

definitions.description: Purge Cache urls
definitions.documentation: Purge Cache urls. POST /zones/{zoneId}/purge_cache. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation PURGE_URLS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Purging urls changes cache state; tags/hosts/prefixes/everything can affect many resources. Limits are conservative local bounds, plan quotas still apply. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.name: Purge Cache custom urls
definitions.description: Purge Cache custom urls
definitions.documentation: Purge Cache custom urls. POST /zones/{zoneId}/purge_cache. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation PURGE_URLS. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Purging custom-urls changes cache state; tags/hosts/prefixes/everything can affect many resources. Limits are conservative local bounds, plan quotas still apply. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation. definitions.documentation: Purge Cache prefixes. POST /zones/{zoneId}/purge_cache. External mutation requires confirmWrites true AND exact confirmation PURGE_PREFIXES. No retries: timeout/failure may have committed; reconcile in Cloudflare before rerunning. Use a least-privilege API token scoped to intended zones/accounts via ONF secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or tokenSecret. Zone Read for zone reads; Zone Edit for zone mutations; DNS Read/Edit for records; Cache Purge for purges. Purging prefixes changes cache state; tags/hosts/prefixes/everything can affect many resources. Limits are conservative local bounds, plan quotas still apply. GET lists return one bounded page and pagination metadata, never silently exhaust all pages. Fixed HTTPS Cloudflare API, redirects rejected, 10 s default / 30 s max timeout plus independently bounded 250 ms response cleanup, request 128 KiB / streamed response 1 MiB. Errors omit token and private provider bodies. Results retain documented selected fields and optional absence/null/falsy values; private DNS content is expected result data. No polling listener or live provider validation.
